svg.title: AI company and all-agent operating canvas
svg.desc: The complete company structure, broker flow, work lifecycle, and specialist-agent responsibilities on one supplied canvas.

text.textPath: END-TO-END MULTI-AGENT BUSINESS + CLAUDE/CODEX BROKER
Stable company roles • Dynamic model assignment • Independent second voice • Deterministic evidence • Human authority

g.text: Final authority to pause, reject, merge or release
One role owns one deliverable • no self-approval • read-only by default
Evidence over confidence • least privilege • sequential until proven safe

text.textPath: A. CONTROLLED BUSINESS WORKFLOW — PHASES 1–9

g.text: Each phase returns a fixed handoff before the next phase begins

text.textPath: B. BROKER CONTROL PLANE — SOFTWARE-ENFORCED MANAGEMENT

g.text: Roles stay stable; Claude and Codex are replaceable workers
Read-only planning/review • write access only in assigned worktree • no push/merge/deploy
Broker-tracked usage • manual capacity overrides • latency • reliability • cache advantage
Only approved inputs for the current role; stable project memory stays in repository docs

text.textPath: C. ONE WORK UNIT — DYNAMIC CLAUDE/CODEX EXECUTION + QUALITY CONVERGENCE

g.text: Retry; never let reviewer silently fix
Release Manager assembles evidence; authorized human decides
SRE • Support • Success • BI feed outcomes back to Product

text.textPath: Animation: elements reveal in business order. In Excalidraw Animate, select elements to adjust Order and Duration.

g.text: Hard rule: deterministic failures or unresolved blockers cannot be outvoted.

text.textPath: INDIVIDUAL AGENT OPERATING ARCHITECTURE — CLAUDE / CODEX BROKER COMPANY
Every role has approved inputs, one responsibility, restricted tools, a document output, an independent review, and a controlled handoff.
A. HOW ONE INDIVIDUAL AGENT RUNS

g.text: Queue • dependency status • context packaging • provider health • token/capacity routing • permissions • audit log • retries • completion policy
DO: trace flows + safe change points
Document states: DRAFT → UNDER REVIEW → APPROVED → SUPERSEDED
Task completed • inputs reviewed • decisions • deliverables
files affected • assumptions • risks • open questions
acceptance status • next role • human approval
Broker adds: work-unit ID • provider/model • run ID • worktree
commands • token usage • gates • verdict • retry • hashes
Real tests, lint, types, build and approved security scanners run first.
Then: Claude reviewer + Codex reviewer + load-balanced arbiter.
COMPLETE = gates pass + 2/3 approve + zero blockers + evidence.
code → Code Writer • tests → QA • delivery → DevOps

text.textPath: Animation order is embedded in each element ID using animateOrder and animateDuration.

g.text: The reviewer never silently fixes the work being judged.

text.textPath: CHIEF OF STAFF — INDIVIDUAL OPERATING ARCHITECTURE
A stable company role dynamically filled by Claude, Codex, or another approved model.

g.text: Clarify the request, choose the workflow, verify handoffs and stop at human gates.
Select primary model; reserve another model as second voice
Other model verifies evidence, boundaries and acceptance criteria
Reviewer does not edit the deliverable
NEXT: Program Manager / Market Researcher / Business Analyst
assumptions • risks • open questions • status • next role
